//exclude: Workspaces have their own tsconfig with a modern target. Excluded wholesale rather than one by one — listing them individually silently broke `next build` each time a new workspace was added (BigInt literals vs this file's ES2017 target). Note `exclude` only filters the initial glob — a file pulled in by an import is still typechecked, which is why apps/ must be excluded too rather than relying on packages/ alone.
